name: abx
description: Put art, images and code on chain as NFTs. Deploy, mint, sell and host collections with ABX by Art Blocks on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum: 1/1s, image series, editions, JavaScript drops and Solidity-rendered work. Store content on chain or off, hosted by ABX or self-hosted. Requires Node 22.13+ and @artblocks/abx-cli.
